notes.title: Patch notes v1.04
notes.content:
Another small update to address some of the bugs blocking players from completing online games. Also includes some UI tweaks for some of the things people have brought up.


UI Tweaks:
Added an indicator on how long it takes to auto continue when showing fighters entering battles.
Clarified that difficulty on affects the AI strength and not the player.
Clarified the names of the different content bundles inside the game.

==============================

Online fixes:
- Fixed a bug where rerolling artefacts prevented the player from finishing their turn.
- Fixed a bug where rerolling artefacts didn't give you new artefacts.
- Fixed a bug which prevented players from completing their turn if they got both prophecy and artefact choices in the same round.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.03
notes.content:
The updates keeps coming to the game. This time I got a new feature for you. Match History!
I'm open for more suggestions for improving the game so let me know if there are anything you would like to see in the game. 


New feature: Match History
Added a history function where you can see the last 10 single player matches you've played. (Starting this patch)

==============================

Adjustments:
- Health can now no longer be lowered below 100 to avoid fighters getting reduced down to 0 health at battle start.

==============================

Online fixes:
- Fixed a bug with XP not showing the correct value in fights causing fight damage to differ from the actual value.
- Fixed a bug which prevented players from completing their turn if they got both prophecy and artefact choices in the same round.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug which caused the player to skip over gaining a prophecy item choice if they were supposed to get the choice at the same round as the artefact choice.
- Fixed a bug where prophecy bonuses were skipped if the player levelled up with the +XP/round artefact.

notes.title: First Balance Patch
notes.content:
Hello again!
This time I finally got around to doing some balance updates to the game. I've been focusing on synergies that are rarely used and on bringing all artefacts to a more even power level. Of course there are also a bunch of bug fixes. I think I got rid of the bug which sometimes freezes the game but let me know if it's still there. A big thank you to all of you who have reported bugs and suggested improvements to the game. I've read every suggestion so far so keep them coming!

Apart from that I'm currently focusing on getting the mobile versions done. The version themselves are pretty much done but I need to get them through the review processes of Google and Apple. 
Wish me luck!


===============================
Adjustments:
- Fixed the fight opponent matching. Now you should not have to face the same opponent multiple times in a row until the end game.
- Healing effects now no longer heal forever. After about 25-50 uses they lose half of their power and then after 50-100 uses they stop working. This is to avoid some very specific fights going on forever.

- Debuff immunity is now split into two separate stats: Purity Shield and Protected Body. This is done to not have Debuff Immunity be the answer to everything, which is actually was, and to allow for some counterplay.

Added 2 new minor artefacts:
- Reinforced Armour: Gives +300 Health, +15 Armour and Barrier, and Protected Body.
- Assassin's Handbook: Gives +15 Crit, +15 Dodge, and the Poison spell.


===============================
Balance changes

Synergies:
- Rogue: Critical hit chance is increased from 15% to 20%.
- Precision: Damage loss have been decreased from 15% to 10%.

Upgrades:
- (5C) Shield of Purity: Debuff Immunity changed to Purity Shield.

Artefacts:
- (Major) Cursed Dubloon: Removed the gold gained on pickup. Changed the poison spell to give the wielder +50 Strength and Purity Shield. Team bonus now also makes all your fighters bleed at the start of fights.
- (Major) Sibling Band: Increased the wielder bonus to 50% Speed instead of 40% damage increase. Duplicate bonus is increased from 40/140 to 60/210 (Strength/Magic).
- (Major) Inheritance Gem: Reduced the Speed from 25/50/75/100% to 20/40/70/100%.
- (Major) Morph Gem: Reduced the power of a few of the transformations.
	- Intelligence Gem: Reduced Mana Generation from 20 to 18.
		Reduced Magic from 65% to 60%.
	- Essence Gem: Increased Lifesteal from 22% to 30%. 
		Reduced Strength from 65% to 60%.
	- Protection Gem: Changed the 200 Armour to 150 Barrier.
	- Agility Gem: Increased Dodge Chance from 25% to 28%. 
		Reduced Speed from 50% to 40%.
	- Chilling Gem: Reduced Freeze chance from 35% to 20%.
- (Major) Noble Contacts: Changed the +2 Coins/Round to +4 XP/Round.
- (Minor) Warding Patch: Changed to Life Essence Amulet. 
		Reduced Barrier from 300 to 250.
- (Tabard) Rogue Tabard: Changed 50% Critical hit to 50% Strength.


===============================

Visual updates:
- HP Reg and Lifesteal amount are now shown with small numbers during fights.

Crash fixes:
- Fixed a bug that sometimes made the game fail to load the next game round.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the game to fail to find your next opponent to fight.
- Stopped the fights from going on forever, freezing the game.

Bug fixes:
- Steam achievements now properly pops up when achieved and not when closing the game.
- The player gets to have their own name during the tutorial.
- Fixed a lot of online bugs regarding levelling artefacts.
- Fixed a bug where healing spells could cause opponents to bleed using cursed artefacts.

notes.title: Patch Notes v 1.01
notes.content:
It's time for the first real update to the game. This time it's just bug fixes so gameplay tweaks will have to wait. Thank you to everyone who found bugs and reported them on the community discord server. I think I've gotten most of them so far. There is one bug which sometimes stops the game after battles. Not really sure what is causing this yet so I need to gather more information before I can pin down the bug.

For the next update I have a few balance tweaks and changes planned along with more bug fixes so stay tuned for that.

Until next time, have fun playing!
/Parrexion


===============================
Patch notes for v 1.01
===============================

Known bug:
- Sometimes the game stops moving after a battle.
Returning to main menu and then going back to the game fixes it sometimes.


Adjustments:
- Tweaked the visuals for Hunting and Venomous.

Crash fixes:
- Fixed a bug where the Mysterious Ore-artefact sometimes caused a crash.
- The game no longer freezes when leaving a fight when paused.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug where rage could cause one player to only use one fighter at a time.
- Item stats are now properly shown during fights when playing online.
- Morph artefacts are now hidden when looking at opponents build from last round.

- DLC items are now properly available if purchased when starting the game for the first time.
- Added missing sfx when dealing player cards.
- Music now stays in calm mode longer during duels.
- The settings for gameplay->autofill now works again.
- The tutorial for game modes are no longer shown unless they are actually unlocked.
